title: Generated package indexes: does the proposed set of pinned versions install cleanly?
decision: whether every pinned version is listed, every requirement of every pinned version is met by a pin, the runtime fits every pinned version and no conflict applies (yes), or exactly one of these fails (no)
licence: generated by the benchmark's script (no third-party text)
notes: 600 items = 300 contrast pairs (group): the two members share every line of the state except one pin line; the negative breaks exactly one condition (bound, missing, own_req, runtime, conflict; meta.deviation). Levels 1-3 (meta.level, 200 items each). All package and environment names are invented; the truth is computed on the structured specification (meta.spec). The number of pins that no pinned version requires is the same in both members of every pair (otherwise it separates the classes without any version comparison). State length 1482 to 10286 characters.
skill: find the entry of each pinned version among look-alike entries and check every requirement, runtime bound and conflict against the pins with number-by-number version comparison
knobs: pins 4-5 / 6-8 / 9-12; versions per package 1-2 / 2-3 / 3-4; runtime from level 2; conflicts and a chain of three requirements at level 3; 1.9-versus-1.10 neighbours; bounds on, just inside and just beyond a limit
